# Agentic Life OS (ALOS)

Open-source, local-first agent runtime with private-instance overlays.

## Public boundary

- Public repository: code, contracts, docs, synthetic fixtures, generic templates.
- Private instance: preferences, local policy identifiers, live authority, sanitized notes.
- Encrypted local vault: raw personal, clinical, genomic, family, and financial data.

## Core modules

- `packages/core`: strict profile schema and loader.
- `packages/health`: sovereign health bridge, admission, projection, and export contracts.
- `packages/memory`: local memory primitives.
- `packages/orchestration`: bounded cross-module composition.
- Other packages are experimental synthetic workflow primitives.

## Health source

Public Health Intelligence System artifacts must be pinned to
`frankxai/health-intelligence-system` by immutable commit, semantic version,
repository-relative path, byte length, and SHA-256. Integrity is not clinical validity.

## Safety

No diagnosis, treatment, medication changes, result interpretation, emergency
reassurance, autonomous transport, or public storage of private records.
